name: telegram
description: Read and search live Telegram dialogs, collect context, and prepare reply drafts through the local telegram-mcp facade.

interface.shortDescription: Read, search, collect context, and draft Telegram replies
interface.longDescription: Use live Telegram dialogs through the local telegram-mcp facade to resolve chats, read recent or date-scoped messages, search conversations, summarize context, inspect scoped media, use built-in Telegram voice transcription, and prepare non-sending reply previews. Default Mode is intentionally restricted to read-only, local media-download, voice-transcription, and preview tools. Power Mode can expose the broader Telegram MCP surface, and Operator Workflows cover mirror/archive/export tasks, but both require separate explicit local setup outside the default plugin allowlist.
defaultPrompt: Read today's chat with @username and summarize the decisions
Search a Telegram dialog for a message or link
Collect context from a Telegram chat and prepare a reply draft
